stem:
Krish fills $\dfrac{1}{8}$ of a tank in one hour. Anvi fills $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the same tank in one hour. They work together.

Which two claims correctly combine their work?

options.text: The combined answer is Krish's individual rate $\dfrac{1}{8}$ alone.
In one hour they fill $\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{4}=\dfrac{3}{8}$ of the tank.
Their combined rate is the sum of the fractions of the tank each fills in one hour.
Treat the times as inversely proportional constants and solve $8\times4=k$ for the joint time.

teacher.key_rationale: Add the hourly work fractions to get the combined rate 3/8 tank per hour. Naming only Krish's rate swaps the combined unit of work for one label. Inverse-proportion constant products are a different mechanism.
